state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 4 (the review) is written whole:** `bun nv scaling --areas --reviewed` prints `every area has a ladder and a review section`, and `docs/perf/performance-review.md` now ends with a `## floor` section: the counts and clocks of an empty run, an empty `nvs check`, one empty request and an empty file in `nvs lsp`, and what each is spent on. Old refusals have not been priced again yet.

**29 gap records owned by `performance-pass`.** The floor added two, both measured with callgrind: `nvs-types/core-signatures-are-built-again-for-every-check` (the `Core` signature table is rebuilt per check: 54% of an empty `nvs check`, 63% of an empty-file editor session) and `nvs-lsp/an-edit-analyses-the-document-twice` (`index.refresh` and `publish` each analyse the same version). `nvs-syntax/an-elseif-chain-is-not-depth-guarded` now has its ladder, `benches/scaling/compiler/elseif.nvs`, which is **invalid** today: the release `nvs check` overflows its stack between 700 and 1024 arms.

**Still red:** `scaling --check` (`fmt/classes.nvs`, `lsp/classes.nvs`, `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` grow, `compiler/elseif.nvs` crashes) and `owners --closes performance-pass` (the 29 gaps). Stage 5 is fixing them. `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` *Decisions for you* has one entry: a total deadline for the request head.

next.title: the fixes, the editor's per-edit floor

items.text: **Analyse an edited document once per version**: `reanalyse` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:485`) calls `index.refresh` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:497`), whose `absorb` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs:609`) analyses the document, and `publish` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:2070`) analyses the same version again. Hand `absorb`'s analysis to `publish` when the versions agree, and close `data/gaps/nvs-lsp/an-edit-analyses-the-document-twice.json`. Rule: `rule:ide/the-server-is-synchronous`, `rule:ide/five-features-are-one-reference-index`.

**Fix `unused_private`'s scan of every occurrence**, then re-run `bun nv scaling lsp/classes` and close `data/gaps/nvs-lsp/unused-private-scans-every-occurrence.json` if the ladder settles. Anchors are in the gap record; `crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs:344` is the refresh it feeds.
**Stop copying an entry's read list into every file it loads** (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs:613`), closing `data/gaps/nvs-lsp/the-index-copies-an-entrys-reads-into-every-file.json`.

backlog: Build `Core` signatures once per process: `data/gaps/nvs-types/core-signatures-are-built-again-for-every-check.json` (`crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:45`). It reaches every check and every editor analysis, so it is worth a session of its own.

Flatten the `elseif` chain so neither spelling nests: `data/gaps/nvs-syntax/an-elseif-chain-is-not-depth-guarded.json`. An AST change across parser, checker, lowering and fmt, and the ladder `benches/scaling/compiler/elseif.nvs` checks it.

Price old refusals again (goal Stage 4 *Old refusals are priced again*): decision records and perf notes under `docs/decisions/` and `docs/perf/` that declined a change on a figure from a smaller tree.
`numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` grows: judged against schoolbook multiplication, it may be a *Benches to look at* entry, not a defect.
